notes: New words and the review block are no longer skippable, and the word counter is gone from the lesson. That line ('10 new words this lesson, 22 more unlocked, coming in later lessons') was stuck on the same number for a reason: the deck hands out exactly as many words as a lesson teaches, so anything you skipped could never come back, and the last words on your path would simply never have been taught. If you are behind, lessons now quietly serve one extra word each until you have caught up. Also in this build: the Croatian wrap-up is fixed. Every lesson now ends by asking you for one word or one phrase, in clear English, and every answer is something you can actually type: the old lesson 11 expected 'kava > kavu', arrow included, and marked all eight answers wrong without it. Lesson 1 asks you for the words, not the letters. Every A0 lesson title is in English again. The wrap-up screen now says which language to answer in and that accents count. Four new build gates make all of this impossible to reintroduce, and the same pass over A1, A2 and B1 is next.
